methodology.activity: AHI Activity Score: cumulative weighted changes observed by AHI. Each available snapshot date is retained as an observation; unchanged days keep the previous score instead of disappearing.
methodology.growth: AHI Growth Index: change in cumulative Activity Score across the available observed window. Daily movement is preserved separately and no missing history is fabricated.
methodology.downloads: Observed download totals from source-attributed external package/model metadata. AHI does not invent pre-import download history.
methodology.rating: No universal cross-ecosystem user rating source is integrated; no value is fabricated.
methodology.security: OpenSSF Scorecard result observed by AHI; a security signal, not a guarantee of security.
methodology.stars: Repository stars observed from source-attributed ecosyste.ms repository metadata.
